versions.text: Criterion: Verify that stall approach is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.2.5.2 Stall approach (see tables LXXXI, LXXXII and LXXXIII for guidance). b. 5.2.5.2.1 Stall warning. c. 5.2.5.2.2 Uncommanded oscillations prior to stall. d. 5.2.5.2.3 Cockpit controls prior to stall. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation. Additional References: 14 CFR 23.201 Wings level stall 14 CFR 25.203 Stall characteristics
